spans.s:
अर्पणं [ऋ-णिच्-ल्युट्]
1 Placing
or putting upon, setting upon;
पादार्पणानुग्रहपूतपृष्ठं

.
--2 Inserting,
placing or putting in.
--3 Giving,
offering, resigning; स्वदेहार्पणनिष्क्रयेण

.
--4
Restoration, delivery, giving back; न्यास˚
Ak.
--5 Piercing, perforating;
तीक्ष्णतुंडार्पणैर्ग्रीवां नखैः सर्वां व्यदारयत् Rām.
(Said to mean also fire, god, an
oblation, a Mantra and the tongue
of fire-Tv.).

]
The heart; flesh in the heart.

आर्पयितृ m. Ved. One who
injures or hurts.
